decision_conditions:
<ol style="margin-top:0cm" start="2" type="1">
 </ol><p><span style="line-height: 107%;">The proposal, by reason of its
     inadequate outlook for future occupiers would result in a poor standard of
     living accommodation for future occupiers to the detriment of their
     residential amenity, Furthermore, due to the siting, proximity to
     boundaries, bulk, scale, height and massing the development would result
     in an overbearing impact and loss of outlook for properties within the
     studio flats. As such, the proposal is contrary to the
     National Planning Policy Framework (2023), Policies D3.D(7) of The London
     Plan (2021), Policy CS1 of the Harrow Core Strategy (2013), and policy DM1
     and DM2 of the Harrow Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013)
     and the adopted Supplementary Planning Document: Residential Design Guide
     Supplementary Planning Document (2010).<span style="font-size: 12pt;"><o:p></o:p></span></span></p><ol style="margin-top:0cm" start="2" type="1">
</ol>

<ol style="margin-top:0cm" start="1" type="1">
 </ol><p><span style="line-height: 107%;">The proposed new dwellings, by
     reason of their cramped backland siting, uncharacteristic positioning; along
     with their bulk, scale, massing and site location, would&nbsp;form an
     isolated, incongruous, unsympathetic and contrived development, that would
     be unduly at odds with the established pattern of development. The
     proposal would therefore be contrary to the high quality design
     aspirations of the National Planning Policy Framework (2023), Policies
     D3.D(1) and D3.D(11) of The London Plan (2021), Core Policy CS1.B of the
     Harrow Core Strategy (2012), Policy DM1 of the Harrow Development
     Management Policies Local Plan (2013) and the adopted Supplementary
     Planning Document: Residential Design Guide (2010).<span style="font-size: 12pt;"><o:p></o:p></span></span></p><ol style="margin-top:0cm" start="1" type="1">
</ol>
description: Demolition and Redevelopment to provide two x two-storey semi-detached dwellings with accommodation in roof ( 1 x 3 Bed and 1 x 4 Bed) and two x single storey semi-detached dwellings ( 2 x 1 Bed); Associated Landscaping; Boundary treatment; Amenity space; Access; Parking; Refuse and Cycle Storage
